```plato
    // A cloth over any polygon mesh, with the mesh's own face table kept so the
    // result reads back out as the same mesh. Vertex numbering is the mesh's:
    // cloth vertex i is mesh position i.
    ClothFromMesh(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertexMass: Mass, compliance: Number, thickness: Length): ClothMesh3D
        => ClothMesh3D(
            Cloth3D(
                self.MeshClothVertices(vertexMass),
                self.MeshSprings(compliance),
                self.MeshBendConstraints(compliance),
                self.ToTriangleMesh.Faces,
                thickness),
            self.Faces);
```
